sections.content: Some characters are special in HTML: < starts a tag, & starts an entity, > closes one. To display them literally, use entity codes like < > &  .
Entities also cover symbols and international characters: © ©, € €, — —, and numeric forms like A for A.
Key points: always escape user-generated content to prevent broken pages and XSS, and   prevents unwanted line breaks in phrases.
